text: True or False: The Pyrrhonist, unlike the Academic skeptic, declines even to assert that knowledge is impossible, on the grounds that such an assertion would itself be a dogmatic claim.
explanation: Pyrrhonism aims at epoché—suspension of judgment—and treats the flat claim 'knowledge is impossible' as itself a dogma, so it withholds even that. The negative-dogmatic thesis that knowledge (in the Stoic sense of infallible apprehension) is impossible is instead the hallmark of the Academic skeptics such as Arcesilaus and Carneades.
